dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes a vascular plant image dataset collected in Alberta, Canada, in 2023, along with associated datasheets and R scripts used for data analysis in the study titled Evaluating species identification apps as a tool for small plot-based surveys of vascular plants in Alberta, Canada.
Instructions for downloading the image dataset are provided in the READMe.txt file.
dct_title_s: Evaluating species identification apps as a tool for small plot-based surveys of vascular plants in Alberta, Canada
